_help: Player parts for tools/art/make_players.py. One entry in 'players' = one sprite sheet assets/players/<id>.png.
Adding a recruit = one more entry. Colors are 4-tone ramps (highlight, base, shadow, deep): a name from
'palettes' or a list of 4 hex colors. 'skin' is a name from 'skins' (or pixel3d.SKINS).
body: a name from 'bodies' (leg/torso length, shoulder width, muscle mass), optionally 'body_tweak' to adjust.
hair: bald | twists | band (headband over short hair) | cap (backwards cap) | buzz | hightop.
face: beard (full beard), goatee, headband (band over any hair; needs band_pal).
top: tank | tee | longtee | hoodie (sleeveless). sleeve: arm sleeve on L or R (sleeve_pal). tight: leg sleeve L or R.
L and R are the player's own left and right. shorts_len 0.6 (short) to 1.12 (past the knee). number: one digit.
Phase 5 parts: hair afro | mohawk | beanie (cap_pal knit, brim_pal cuff and pom) | capf (cap worn forward, cap_pal,
brim_pal). top bib = overalls (top_pal) over a tee (trim_pal; the buckles use chain_pal, default GOLD).
chain: true (necklace, chain_pal), wrist: true (wristbands on both arms, wrist_pal), shades: true (dark glasses).
'action': [animation, frame] shown in docs/art/players_preview_p5.png. 'recruit': true also writes
<id>_crew.png: the same player with the palette names swapped by 'crew_recolor'[crew] (your blue and gold).
P8-05: 'draft': true (every city average player and every New York player) gets the same _crew recolor, made by
tools/art/make_players_v2.py only (a drafted player wears your colors); 'recruit' stays the recruits' flag.
Phase 6 (P6-A1): 'phase': 6 marks the new players (preview docs/art/players_preview_p6.png). number may have 2 digits.
New hair: cornrows | locs_tied | shaggy | sides (shaved sides, short top) | bun | slick (combed back) | part (fade
with a shaved part); braids: true (short braids at the nape). Extras: flannel (checked top), no_number, patch (cross
patch on the left chest, patch_pal), towel L/R (over that shoulder, towel_pal), waist_jacket (jacket_pal), whistle
(on the chain, whistle_pal), glasses_up / glasses_collar (spare shades, glasses_pal, collar_pal), goggle_tan, hand_pal (chalk or
tape on the hands), kneepads L | R | both (pad_pal). Drawn in make_players.py 'Phase 6 parts'.
Phase 9 (P9-04) era parts for the Grandfathers (Legends Chapter 1), drawn in make_players.py 'Phase 9 era parts':
era_shorts: true (short snug shorts), socks: 'striped' (tall tube socks with two bands at the top, stripe_pal and
stripe2_pal), terry: true (a thick ribbed headband over any hair, an afro too; band_pal), chops: true (mutton
chops), mustache: true, hair flattop, and the kneepads above in an era pad_pal. Era colors are the ERA_* palettes
(made up, no real team's colors); legend sheets are added by P9-09. Look sample: make_players.py --legends-sample.
P9-09: the six Grandfathers legends are crew 'GR' (ids lg_*, original characters, numbers approved by the owner), each
'draft': true (a _crew recolor through crew_recolor 'GR' and the _crew_j1..3 jerseys); every lg_ sheet carries the
hook extra pages. Kits match the P9-10 portraits. Contact sheet: make_players_v2.py --legends-strip.
Phase 10 (P10-04) era parts for the Fathers (Legends Chapter 2), drawn in make_players.py 'Phase 10 era parts':
baggy: true (knee-length baggy shorts, wider, with a side panel in shorts_trim), socks: 'crew' (short crew socks
with one band at the top, stripe_pal), hair durag (a cloth cap tied at the back with two tails, rag_pal; no hair
shows), and the older parts the era reuses as they are: sleeve L | R (the arm sleeve), tight L | R (the leg shooting
sleeve; under baggy shorts it shows from the knee down), wrist (wristbands), cornrows (+ braids), goatee, headband.
Era colors are the ERA2_* palettes (made up; no pair that is a real team's colors, e.g. never purple with gold,
orange, teal or silver). Hard rule: the era parts are spread over the six legends; no legend wears the cornrows +
single arm sleeve + headband set on a small quick guard. Look sample: make_players.py --legends-sample fathers.

_help: P8-09: the 3 alternate jerseys (star rewards jersey_1..3, Cosmetics.ITEMS). Palette only: every sheet that
wears your colors (the underdogs and every <id>_crew recolor) gets palettes/<id>_j<N>.png, its own palette with
your three kit ramps (BLUE, NAVY, GOLD: the 4 tones, the inner line and the outline the renderer derives
from the deep tone) swapped for these (a palette name or 4 hex tones). Same pages, nothing re-rendered:
tools/art/make_players_v2.py --jerseys (also run after every full render).
